places.label: Gare du Nord
places.description: First steps outside the station, on pale stone and a long morning pavement.

places.label: Canal Saint-Martin
places.description: A quiet canal promenade under plane trees, with an iron footbridge.

places.label: Marais market street
places.description: Covered stalls, flowers and small doors in the Marais.

places.label: Left Bank café
places.description: A calm corner café with empty tables on a Left Bank side street.

places.label: The Seine and the Eiffel Tower
places.description: The river widens and the tower comes into view as the light softens.

places.label: Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur
places.description: Broad Montmartre steps rise toward Sacré-Cœur above warm stone terraces.

places.label: Place des Vosges
places.description: Brick arcades and clipped trees frame the quiet paths of Place des Vosges.

places.label: Luxembourg Garden
places.description: The Luxembourg Garden opens behind its railings, with pale paths and green chairs.

places.label: Pont Alexandre III
places.description: Pont Alexandre III crosses the Seine beneath gilded lamps and a wide Paris sky.

places.label: Saint-Germain bookshop street
places.description: A narrow Saint-Germain street passes old bookshop windows and shaded café fronts.
